title: Reflection Steering: Disentangling Reflection from Reasoning in Activation Space for Token-Efficient Inference
abstract: arXiv:2608.25542v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large reasoning models often produce reasoning traces with verification, revision, and backtracking. When reflection merely re-checks established results, it wastes reasoning tokens and increases latency. Most existing reflection steering methods add a label-derived mean-difference direction across preset layers, but its entanglement with reasoning and length signals destabilizes the accuracy-efficiency trade-off. In this paper, we propose Reflection Steering, a training-free framework for controlling reflection-associated computation within LLMs by disentangling reflection-related activations from general reasoning. Specifically, we contrast reflective and non-reflective hidden states at each LLM layer, denoise the resulting reflection directions with PCA, and orthogonalize them against general-reasoning directions. translated_title: 反射引导：在激活空间中解耦反射与推理，实现令牌高效推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25542v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大型推理模型通常产生带有验证、修订和回溯的推理轨迹。当反射仅仅重新检查已确立的结果时，会浪费推理令牌并增加延迟。大多数现有的反射引导方法在预设层上添加基于标签的均值差异方向，但其与推理和长度信号的纠缠破坏了准确性-效率权衡的稳定性。在本文中，我们提出反射引导，一种无训练框架，通过将反射相关激活与一般推理解耦，来控制大型语言模型中的反射相关计算。具体来说，我们在每个大型语言模型层对比反射和非反射隐藏状态，使用主成分分析去噪所得反射方向，并将其与一般推理方向正交化。为限制早期层干预的下游放大效应，我们跨多个干预步骤校准每一层。
tldr: 本文提出一种无训练的反射引导框架，通过主成分分析去噪和正交化，在激活空间中解耦反射与推理信号，从而减少无效推理令牌并优化推理效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a training-free reflection steering framework that disentangles reflection from reasoning signals in activation space via PCA denoising and orthogonalization, reducing ineffective reasoning tokens and improving inference efficiency.
